functions.description: Build sorted entry table from key list
functions.notes: Control flow, stack layout (tmp at sp+0x1c/0x3c), bitfield updates, struct-copy ldm/stm (Record as unsigned int v[8]; memcpy/scalar-field struct assign emits a helper call instead), cocktail-sort shape and final init loop all match. Remaining: register allocation (i/total/withData/kp and p/lastSwap rotated vs target) and pass-2 count: target keeps (short)count in r7 re-loaded from [sp+0x80] while ours reuses spilled n at [sp+0x14] (2 extra ldr, size +4). MWCC unifies n and count via copy-prop; short n, c2 copy and removing n all worsen prologue/spills. colorsweep --apply found a lo->i reuse that is not semantically equivalent, so it was not kept.
